rules.rationale: Homepage course-reserve reading guidance directly supports geography coursework and takes priority over dated-post routing.
The homepage links the book collection and describes geographical books and course reserves as learning resources.
The homepage explicitly links the thesis collection and describes UBC research and teaching materials including Masters and PhD theses.
Homepage navigation identifies centre access, staff, geographic collections, photo requests and payment as public services.
Dated homepage links report holiday closures, ordering deadlines and collection announcements, apart from the specific course-reading override.

fallback.rationale: The Geographic Information Centre provides access to geography collections and practical public and student services at UBC Vancouver.
